nameOrigin: a mammal in the weasel family

pokedexEntries.ru: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these POKéMON are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.

pokedexEntries.sa: SABLEYE digs the ground with sharpened claws to find rocks that it eats. Substances in the eaten rocks crystallize and rise up to the POKéMON’s body surface.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

pokedexEntries.em: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A SABLEYE lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
